text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Six PV sites in one 25 km by 23 km box in Lincolnshire, hourly daylight rows, 2019 to 2026. Each row is one setup's mean absolute error minus another's, pooled over the six sites, in percentage points of capacity: each site's 99th percentile of output. Each label gives both setups' own errors. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Each panel has its own x scale. CAMS and ERA5 describe weather that has already happened, so this measures what the beam field carries, not forecast skill. Planned: one of the comparisons written into the study plan before any result existed. Every other row is exploratory.'
